title: 第5章 谁在骂我第6章 谁敢欺负我你就帮我揍他
lines: “天梯考核还未结束？”
“是，还差半个时辰结束。”
火魅点点头，强忍着体内传来的阵阵虚弱，说道：“帮我去宗门喊青竹来，我留在这里等她。”
“请长老稍等，我这就去。”
陈老看的出来，火魅长老的伤势极其严重，甚至都无法自己走回宗门。
坐在石凳上，虚弱的火魅单手托着下巴，眼神却极其森冷。
“小子，让我找到你，非阉了你不可。”
嚏！
路上。
林铮连续打了两个喷嚏，皱着眉头自语道：“谁在骂我。”
“小子，当年你爹的那些武学，我已经全部灌入你的元神，随着你的境界提升，你可以不断参悟适合你的武学。”
“我父亲到底在何处？”
“我已经说过，现在的你还没有资格问主人的事情。”
“那要等到何时？”
“到时候我会告诉你。”
有些落寞。
当年父母托人将自己送回家族，一去不回，至今下落不明，好不容易有些消息，塔灵却不愿意告诉自己。
“小子，想要知道你父母的事情，就要好好修炼，没有实力，就算我告诉你，你又能如何。”
嗡！
伴随着剑吟咆哮，一柄纯黑色长剑突然悬浮而出。
“这是主人当年纵横大陆的弑神剑，原本我想着等你突破九转弑神诀的第一转，我再将弑神剑给你。”
“谢谢！”
“塔爷累了，先休息。”
紧紧握着手里的弑神剑，林铮脸上写满了坚定。
“我一定会变的足够强大！”
三焱城，城主府。
黄昏下，幽静的庭院。
坐在轮椅上的洛清漪，左手托着下巴，漂亮的大眼睛有些愣神，满脑子全部都是那个人的身影，挥之不去。
“在想我？”
突然听到身后传来的声音，洛清漪的身体轻轻一颤，急忙转动轮椅。
低着头，整张脸通红犹如熟透的红苹果，洛清漪并未否认。
“清漪，我时间有限，这次回来帮你觉醒体内血脉后，我会前往湮鼎宗。”
“林大哥，我觉醒血脉，真的能够站起来吗？”
来到洛清漪前，蹲下身，摸着双腿，林铮笑着说道：“相信我。”
“我信。”
“走，我们回房。”
脸越发的红起来，洛清漪的声音低的犹如蚊子般。
“林大哥，我们还未成亲。”
“你会错意了，我的意思是现在帮你觉醒体内的帝品血脉。”
羞死人了！
房间内。
“塔爷，如何相助清漪觉醒血脉。”
“觉醒的事情交给我，不过过程会很痛苦，只能靠你按着。”
content_en:
"The ladder assessment is not over yet?"
"Yes, it's still half an hour away."
Huo Mei nodded, resisting the waves of weakness coming from her body, and said: "Help me go to the sect and call Qingzhu. I'll stay here and wait for her."
"Elder, please wait a moment, I'll go right away."
Elder Chen could see that Elder Huo Mei's injuries were extremely serious and he could not even walk back to the sect on his own.
Sitting on the stone bench, the weak Huo Mei held her chin with one hand, but her eyes were extremely cold.
"Boy, if I find you, I have to castrate you."
Sneeze!
On the road.
Lin Zheng sneezed twice in a row, frowned and said to himself: "Who is scolding me?"
"Boy, I have poured all of your father's martial arts into your soul. As your realm improves, you can continue to learn the martial arts that suit you."
"Where is my father?"
"I have already said that you are not qualified to ask the master's questions now."
"When will that wait?"
"I'll tell you then."
Somewhat lonely.
Back then, his parents asked someone to send him back to his family, but he never returned. His whereabouts are still unknown. He finally got some news, but Ta Ling was unwilling to tell him.
"Boy, if you want to know about your parents, you have to practice hard. If you don't have the strength, what can you do even if I tell you."
Buzz!
Accompanied by the roar of the sword, a pure black long sword suddenly floated out.
"This is the God-killing sword that the master used across the continent. Originally, I thought that I would give you the God-killing sword after you broke through the first turn of the Nine-turn God-Killing Art."
"Thank you!"
"Master Ta, I'm tired. Let's rest first."
Holding the God-killing Sword tightly in his hand, Lin Zheng's face was filled with determination.
"I will definitely become strong enough!"
Sanyan City, the city lord's mansion.
At dusk, quiet courtyard.
Luo Qingyi was sitting in a wheelchair, holding her chin with her left hand. Her beautiful big eyes were a little dazed, and her mind was filled with the image of that person, which she couldn't get rid of.
"Thinking of me?"
Suddenly hearing a voice from behind, Luo Qingyi's body trembled slightly and she hurriedly turned her wheelchair.
"Yeah."
With his head lowered and his entire face as red as a ripe red apple, Luo Qingyi did not deny it.
"Qingyi, my time is limited. After I come back to help you awaken the blood in your body, I will go to the Diding Sect."
"Brother Lin, can I really stand up after I awaken my bloodline?"
When he came to Luo Qingyi, he squatted down and touched his legs. Lin Zheng smiled and said, "Trust me."
"I believe it."
"Come on, let's go back to the room."
Her face turned redder and redder, and Luo Qingyi's voice was as low as a mosquito.
"Brother Lin, we are not married yet."
"You may have misunderstood. What I mean is to help you awaken the imperial bloodline in your body now."
So shameful!
inside the room.
"Master Ta, how can I help Qingyi awaken her bloodline?"
"Leave the awakening to me, but the process will be very painful. I can only rely on you to hold it down."
title_en: Chapter 5 Who is scolding me? Chapter 6 Who dares to bully me? Beat him up for me.
